cases.source: const a=new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(0n,"UTC"),b=new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(1500000000n,"UTC");if(a.until(b,{smallestUnit:"second",roundingMode:"floor"}).seconds!==1||a.since(b,{smallestUnit:"second",roundingMode:"floor"}).seconds!==-2)throw 1;let log="";a.until(b,{get largestUnit(){log+="l";return "hour";},get roundingIncrement(){log+="i";return 1;},get roundingMode(){log+="m";return "trunc";},get smallestUnit(){log+="s";return "nanosecond";}});if(log!=="lims")throw 2;

const a=new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(0n,"UTC"),b=new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(0n,"+00:00");let ok=false;try{a.until(b,{largestUnit:"day"});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok)throw 1;for(const unit of ["day","week","month","year"]){const d=a.until(a,{largestUnit:unit});if(d.sign!==0||d.years!==0||d.hours!==0)throw 2;}if(a.until(b,{largestUnit:"hour"}).sign!==0)throw 3;

const a=new Temporal.ZonedDateTime(0n,"UTC");let touched=false,ok=false;try{a.until("invalid",{get largestUnit(){touched=true;return "hour";}});}catch(e){ok=e instanceof RangeError;}if(!ok||touched)throw 1;class Z extends Temporal.ZonedDateTime{}if(!(new Z(0n,"UTC").until(a) instanceof Temporal.Duration))throw 2;
